stories.headline: Fire contained on platform in Iran’s South Pars gas field
stories.text: Iranian authorities contained a fire that broke out on a platform in the South Pars gas field. The Pars Oil and Gas Company stated the fire occurred on Tuesday on a gas platform in Phase 14 of the South Pars field. Kourosh Dehghan stated that 17 workers jumped into the sea to save their lives during the incident. Bushehr’s crisis management office later reported that all 17 workers were in good condition after boarding lifeboats and rescue craft.

stories.headline: India has potential to lead next biotech-driven industrial revolution: Dr Jitendra
stories.text: Dr Jitendra Singh stated that India's bioeconomy expanded from about USD 10 billion to more than USD 195 billion. Dr Jitendra Singh stated that India's biotechnology startup ecosystem grew from around 50-60 startups to more than 11,000. Dr Jitendra Singh cited biofoundry hubs in Mohali, Hyderabad, Pune and Thiruvananthapuram. A Letter of Intent was signed between the Biotechnology Research and Innovation Council and the United Kingdom's Centre for Process Innovation.

stories.headline: Russia expels Moldovan diplomat in tit-for-tat move
stories.text: Russia expelled a Moldovan diplomat in retaliation for the expulsion of a Russian embassy employee by Chisinau. Russia’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs summoned Moldova’s ambassador, Lilian Darii, on Tuesday to announce the measure. Moldovan President Maia Sandu stated last month that a Russian attack drone crashed near homes and an energy facility. Moldova launched a new 400-kilovolt power line connecting to Romania and the European grid on Sunday.

stories.headline: USDA cuts Ukraine wheat export forecast – impact on Black Sea prices
stories.text: The United States Department of Agriculture reduced Ukraine's 2026/27 wheat export forecast to 11.5 million tons in its November update. The United States Department of Agriculture upgraded Ukraine's 2026/27 wheat harvest estimate to 26.5 million tons and end-season stocks to 7.3 million tons. stories.headline: Oil prices touch two-month lows on softened US tone toward Iran
stories.text: Brent futures dropped by $1.93, reaching $90.64 a barrel at 10:28 ET on Tuesday. US West Texas Intermediate crude fell by $1.44 to trade at $85.41 on Tuesday. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio stated on Tuesday that economic sanctions and a naval blockade are working effectively against Iran. Data released on Tuesday revealed that US consumer prices increased by more than expected in October.

stories.headline: India reiterates safe passage through Hormuz amid rising attacks on commercial shipping
stories.text: India reiterated its call for free and safe navigation through the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday. External Affairs Ministry spokesperson Randhir Jaiswal stated that New Delhi is in touch with all concerned parties regarding attacks on civilian vessels. The West Asia conflict began in February following US and Israeli strikes on Iran. The Iran-backed Houthi group recently targeted Saudi Arabia's East-West oil pipeline.

stories.headline: India Discusses Food Corridors with Russia and Ukraine, Reiterates Proposals on Black Sea Shipping and Exports
stories.text: At its 10 November 2026 briefing, the Ministry of External Affairs detailed India's ongoing discussions with Russia and Ukraine. Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi spoke with Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy on 9 November regarding the conflict and peace efforts. External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar spoke with Russian Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov on 9 November about diplomatic initiatives. stories.headline: Nifty PSU Bank Index Performance: Bank of India, UCO Bank among 7 stocks rebound 15–56% from 1-yr lows - here’s why
stories.text: The Nifty PSU Bank index surged nearly 4% in the previous session, marking its biggest single-day gain in almost two years. Bank of Maharashtra led the pack with a 58% rebound from its 52-week low. The net interest income of public sector banks grew 15.9% year-on-year. stories.text: AuthBridge is headquartered in Gurugram and has spent nearly two decades building a comprehensive platform for background verification. stories.text: GIFT Nifty advanced nearly 0.6% on Tuesday, pointing towards a positive market opening for the Nifty 50 on Wednesday, November 11. stories.headline: ‘Temple is made for the world’: Deepinder Goyal says doesn’t expect more than 1% sale in India amid debate over pricing
stories.text: Deepinder Goyal defended the pricing of Temple, an upcoming forehead-worn wellness gadget, and stated that pre-orders opened on November 1 at a price of ₹ 85,000. Deepinder Goyal stated that shipments for Temple devices will start in early 2027, with delivery expected within 3 months of ordering. Deepinder Goyal stated that Temple was built for the global market and expects no more than 1% of sales to happen in India. Deepinder Goyal clarified that Temple is strictly a fitness and artificial intelligence device that does not make medical claims or replace doctors.

stories.headline: Meet Chirag Munjani: From corporate job to rural tourism, how Gujarat man built experiential travel company
stories.text: Chirag Munjani started a Vadodara-based proprietorship known as Rural Pleasure Journeys in 2012. stories.text: India's central bank has informed certain lenders regarding the necessity to modify their bond forward accounting methods. stories.text: The 2-year Treasury yield climbed 5 basis points to reach 4.56%. Traders are pricing in less easing from the Federal Reserve based on the yield climb.

stories.text: Microsoft began testing Automatic Super Resolution on the Xbox Ally X in April, when usage was restricted to docked mode. stories.text: Colt Data Centre Services began construction on a new data center facility in Berlin, Germany.
